Lemma
[Frame-bundle commutators] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0449, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0450 ↗ def:chow-ii-horizontal-frame-fields ↗ def:chow-ii-vertical-frame-fields 1. appf:F.16,appf:F.17\group Frame Bundle Calculus

On $\mathcal F\mathcal M$, \[ [ abla _a, abla _b]=-R^d{}_{abc}\Lambda ^c_d, \quad [\Lambda ^a_b, abla _c]=\delta ^a_c abla _b, \quad [\Lambda ^a_b,\Lambda ^c_d]=\delta ^a_d\Lambda ^c_b-\delta ^c_b\Lambda ^a_d. \] Consequently, for a $(p,q)$-tensor $U$, \[ [ abla _c, abla _d]U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p} =-\sum _{\ell =1}^pR^f{}_{cdb_\ell e}U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots f\cdots b_p} +\sum _{k=1}^qR^{a_k}{}_{cde}U^{a_1\cdots e\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p}. \]
